hero.headline: Help students speak English with confidence.
hero.subheadline: Bridges Institute brings qualified English-speaking teachers into schools across the Negev to lead active English lessons — movement, games, stories, role-play and real communication.

meaning.title: Real meaning
meaning.body: You help students who freeze up in English build the confidence to use it.

active.title: Active classrooms
active.body: You're on your feet: games, stories, role-play, movement. Not reading from a textbook.

support.title: Teaching materials
support.body: Teaching materials are provided for the programme.

personality.title: Room for personality
personality.body: Warmth, presence and reliability matter here. Teachers bring themselves into the room.

job.title: A lesson at Bridges, step by step.
job.quote: Meaning first. Speech when ready. Confidence throughout.
job.method: Students first understand English through actions, pictures, objects, stories and teacher modelling. They begin speaking when they are ready and then use the language in games and real communication.
flow: Students meet new language through actions, pictures, objects and stories.
The teacher models the language; students respond with movement and gesture first.
They repeat useful words and phrases out loud once they are ready.
Younger students: actions, pictures, objects, rhythm, movement and stories.
Older students: opinions, role-play, interviews, real-life situations and conversation tasks.
The language is then used in games and real communication.

meta.title: Teach English in the Negev — Bridges Institute
meta.description: Bridges Institute recruits qualified English-speaking teachers for full-time and part-time roles in schools across the Negev. A recognised academic degree and fluent or near-native English are required.
